_comment: The application commit this workflow is approved to deploy.
A 40-hex app_sha input establishes SYNTAX, not approval. Every commit on
every branch is 40 hex characters. This file is the approval, it lives on
the default branch, and changing it is a reviewed change.
The candidate checkout never supplies its own approval: this file is read
from the operational checkout (the commit the workflow itself ran from),
never from the application commit under deployment.
Future acceptances are a one-line edit here, reviewed like any other.
packageLabel: Expo package: kiosk link control, truthful email verification state, and station enrolment. REVERTED from 3ca7f9e on the Director's 02:18 ET instruction not to stage 120f032; 3ca7f9e is its descendant and carries the same three contract gaps.
